title: Hearthfall
description: Lead a clan from fur-clad cavemen to modern townsfolk through the Ember, Kiln and Forge ages, keep the fires lit through wolf-haunted nights and hungry winters, and burn your rival's Hearth Hall.
controls: Mouse: left-click to select, right-click to command, WASD or screen edges to pan, wheel to zoom. Touch: tap to select and command, drag to pan, pinch to zoom.
requirements: Any modern browser. Desktop or tablet recommended.
